local_verification_desktop.important: The live data directory is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude-Data\claude_pzs8sxrjxfjjc\ (README.txt in Claude-Data). %APPDATA%\Claude holds only a marker file; %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\Claude_pzs8sxrjxfjjc holds MSIX settings/virtualised stubs

%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Claude-Data\\claude_pzs8.claude-code-sessions/<accountUuid>/local: desktop 'Code tab' session metadata (24 json files). keys: cliSessionId, cwd, originCwd, model, effort, permissionMode, createdAt, lastActivityAt, lastFocusedAt, completedTurns, isArchived, cliBinaryPin.{version,wrapper}, postTurnSummary.*, envScopeId, gitAnchors*. cliSessionId links to ~/.claude/projects/*/<sessionId>.jsonl
%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Claude-Data\\claude_pzs8.claude-code/<version>/: bundled Claude Code CLI binaries (2.1.304, 2.1.308) -> evidence of CLI versions run
%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Claude-Data\\claude_pzs8.local-agent-mode-sessions/<uuid>/: cowork / local agent mode sessions (3) + skills-plugin
%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Claude-Data\\claude_pzs8.scratch-workspaces/<uuid>/<uuid>/scratch: per-session scratch working folders (this is where sessions started without a project folder live)
%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Claude-Data\\claude_pzs8.git-shadow/, git-worktrees.json: worktree bookkeeping; git-worktrees.json records origin repo paths/urls per project
%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Claude-Data\\claude_pzs8.claude_desktop_config.json: preferences incl. per-account flags (bypassPermissionsGate, scheduled tasks, cowork browser tools); no mcpServers on this PC. Contains account UUIDs - treat as identifiers

layout.%APPDATA%\\Claude-NativeHost\\: chrome-native-host.exe + com.anthropic.claude_browser_extension.json (native messaging manifest for the Claude browser extension -> evidence that the Chrome extension is installed)

forensic_notes: Chat conversations for claude.ai are server-side; locally only IndexedDB/cache fragments exist. The desktop Code-tab sessions reference CLI sessions (cliSessionId) whose transcripts are in ~/.claude/projects
Packaged (MSIX) apps may redirect %APPDATA%/%LOCALAPPDATA% writes - collect from Claude-Data AND the Packages folder
Logs rotate by size (main.log -> main1.log -> main2.log); acquire all
